# Feature_Tree_Widget

`Feature_Tree_Widget` displays `DataManager` keys with optional organization by
data type and name-derived groups. The default grouping rule recognizes keys that
end in `_number` or `_number` followed by one alphabetic unit label.

Examples:

- `voltage_11` groups under `voltage`
- `voltage_raw_11` groups under `voltage_raw`
- `spikes_11a`, `spikes_11b`, and `spikes_12a` group under `spikes`

Callers can still override grouping with `setGroupingPattern(...)`; the default
only affects widgets that do not provide their own pattern.
